What happens when books containing fabricated history, imaginary authors and AI-generated content are purchased using public money and placed inside government libraries?
Tamil Nadu is at the centre of a major controversy after celebrated Tamil novelist Perumal Murugan raised questions about thousands of suspicious books found at Coimbatore's Periyar Arivulagam public library. Some books reportedly contained glaring historical inaccuracies, invented authors and fabricated accounts of Tamil literary history. Others carried unusually high price tags.
